name: Alex Jayne Go
bio: Alex Jayne Go is an Asian-American actress and voiceover artist from Orange County, CA. She started as a model for Old Navy and GAP, then began acting in 2015. Recently, Alex worked on a couple of feature films as lead, and looks forward to seeing the final edit on the big screen.

credits.title: Ally
credits.overview: A squid dreams of becoming the star of a wildlife documentary. But when an aircraft sinks into the ocean, her peaceful world is suddenly thrown into danger.

credits.title: Little Angels
credits.overview: After a hotshot college football coach is suspended and sentenced to community service, he's forced to coach a ragtag girls' soccer team—learning humility, teamwork, and personal growth along the way.

credits.title: Heritage Day
credits.overview: After Evie dresses up like her estranged grandmother, a Holocaust survivor, on “Heritage Day” at school, she becomes increasingly obsessed with this dark part of her family history.

credits.title: Who Killed Santa? A Murderville Murder Mystery
credits.overview: A holiday-hating detective is forced to solve a murder — and save Christmas — with help from famous trainees who must improv their way through the case.

credits.title: Pooka!
credits.overview: A struggling actor gets a holiday season job as a Christmas character in a plush suit to promote the hottest toy of the year, Pooka; he slowly develops two personalities—one when he's in the suit and one that's outside it.

credits.title: Searching
credits.overview: After David Kim's 16-year-old daughter goes missing, a local investigation is opened and a detective is assigned to the case. But 37 hours later and without a single lead, David decides to search the one place no one has looked yet, where all secrets are kept today: his daughter's laptop.

credits.title: Little Big Awesome
credits.overview: Two inseparable buddies, Gluko and Lennon, are in for a wonderfully strange adventure. Not only must they get a lost little bubble back home to Bubble Land, they need to make it back in time to stop a group of adorable yet naughty kittens from messing up Grandma's house.
